Container.Name: Mammatus
Container.Overview:
Mammatus is a self-hosted weather model viewer. HRRR, RRFS, GFS, ECMWF IFS and AIFS maps on a realistic 3D globe that morphs into a flat map, with live radar and satellite, GOES lightning drawn as animated bolts, WPC fronts, NWS alerts, multi-model meteograms, skew-T soundings, user accounts and real push notifications. Put it behind your reverse proxy (HTTPS) for remote access and install it as an app on phones.
First run: open the WebUI and use the one-time setup code printed in the container log, or set MAMMATUS_ADMIN_USER / MAMMATUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.
Container.Requires: A reverse proxy with HTTPS (for example Nginx Proxy Manager) is needed for remote access and push notifications.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web interface port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, keys and the frame cache.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The https:// address people use (for example https://wx.example.com). Used for invite links and secure cookies.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Default display time zone (each user can change theirs).

Config.Name: Contact email
Config.Description: Sent in the User-Agent to NOAA/NWS and used as the Web Push contact. Recommended.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Comma-separated models to offer.

Config.Name: Lightning satellites
Config.Description: GOES lightning sources: east,west (Americas, Atlantic and Pacific), east (enough for the lower 48), or off. Data is only downloaded while someone has the lightning layer on (about 100 MB/hour for both, 65 MB/hour for east).

Config.Name: Lightning backfill (min)
Config.Description: History fetched when the lightning layer is first turned on (10-120). Older radar frames fetch their lightning on demand.

Config.Name: Cache size (GB)
Config.Description: Upper bound for the on-disk frame cache.

Config.Name: Sky cache size (GB)
Config.Description: Upper bound for the Sky view cache (3D cloud boxes around viewed points).

Config.Name: Terrain tiles
Config.Description: Elevation tiles for the Sky view's real terrain. Leave empty for Terrain Tiles on AWS (free, no key); any Terrarium-encoded {z}/{x}/{y} tile server works, or 'off' to use only the weather model's coarse terrain.

Config.Name: Terrain cache size (GB)
Config.Description: Upper bound for cached elevation tiles and terrain patches (about 9 MB per new place opened in the Sky view).

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Addresses/CIDRs allowed to set X-Forwarded-For/Proto. Defaults to private networks; set to your proxy's IP (e.g. 10.0.10.2/32) to tighten.

Config.Name: HSTS
Config.Description: Send Strict-Transport-Security (only when always served over HTTPS).

Config.Name: Admin username (first run)
Config.Description: Optional: create this admin on first start instead of using the setup code.

Config.Name: Admin password (first run)
Config.Description: Optional: password for the first-run admin. Remove after setup.

Config.Name: Open-Meteo URL
Config.Description: Point forecasts and soundings. Point at a self-hosted Open-Meteo or the commercial endpoint if you like.

Config.Name: Open-Meteo API key
Config.Description: Optional commercial API key.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as.
